invariants.rationale: All switch cases either return a non-null object or throw, so result is non-null when the method exits.
The method returns only if sortMode is NONE or GLOBAL_SORT; otherwise, it throws an exception.
The method always returns an instance of BulkInsertPartitioner.
If sortMode is NONE, a JavaNonSortPartitioner is returned; otherwise not.
If sortMode is GLOBAL_SORT, a JavaGlobalSortPartitioner is returned; otherwise not.
